candidates.summary: `_preview/` ignores the render output but not `_preview.changed`, the sibling leftover the tool's own Makefile writes beside it
candidates.failure_scenario: A contributor runs `make run` in `misc/gnopreview`; the `run` target's first line is `git -C $(GNOROOT) diff --name-only $(BASE)... > $(OUT).changed`, so `misc/gnopreview/_preview.changed` appears, holding that developer's own changed-file list. `git check-ignore -v --no-index misc/gnopreview/_preview.changed` returns NOT IGNORED, so it shows in `git status` for the rest of the session and a `git add -A` commits it. `make clean` removes it, which is the author's own statement that it is a build leftover; the diff ignored the other two leftovers that target produces and missed this one.
candidates.verify_by: cd <head worktree> && git check-ignore -v --no-index misc/gnopreview/_preview.changed misc/gnopreview/_preview/x — the second matches `.gitignore:14:_preview/`, the first matches nothing; `sed -n '6,20p' misc/gnopreview/Makefile` shows `OUT ?= _preview`, `> $(OUT).changed` in `run` and `rm -rf $(OUT) $(OUT).changed` in `clean`
candidates.evidence: git check-ignore -v --no-index: `misc/gnopreview/_preview/x` -> `.gitignore:14:_preview/`; `misc/gnopreview/_preview.changed` -> NOT IGNORED. Makefile: `OUT ?= _preview`, run writes `$(OUT).changed`, clean does `rm -rf $(OUT) $(OUT).changed`.

candidates.summary: both entries belong in a per-tool `misc/gnopreview/.gitignore`, the shape six other `misc/` tools already use
candidates.failure_scenario: The root `.gitignore` gains its first path-anchored line for one `misc/` tool's binary (the merge base's `Build leftovers` block is `build` and `dist` alone), and an unanchored `_preview/` that matches at every depth of the repo for an artifact only this tool writes. `misc/gnoe2e/.gitignore` is the precedent: `/build` and `/gnoe2e`, anchored inside the tool's own directory; `gendocs`, `stdlib_diff`, `genproto`, `loop` and `val-scenarios` each carry their own file too. A `misc/gnopreview/.gitignore` of `/gnopreview`, `/_preview/` and `/_preview.changed` covers all three leftovers, keeps the pattern scoped to the directory that produces them, and leaves the root file unchanged.
candidates.verify_by: find <head worktree>/misc -maxdepth 2 -name .gitignore && cat misc/gnoe2e/.gitignore — six per-tool files, gnoe2e's being `/build` and `/gnoe2e`; git show <merge base>:.gitignore | grep -n 'misc' returns nothing
candidates.evidence: find misc -maxdepth 2 -name .gitignore: gendocs, stdlib_diff, gnoe2e, genproto, loop, val-scenarios. misc/gnoe2e/.gitignore is `/build` + `/gnoe2e`. Merge-base .gitignore Build-leftovers block: `build`, `dist`, no misc path.

dropped.summary: `_preview/` is unanchored where the same file's last block states the root-anchoring convention (`/config/`, with the comment `Root-anchored so nested config/ package directories are never hidden`)
dropped.settled_by: `sed -n '1,20p' misc/gnopreview/Makefile` shows `OUT ?= _preview` with `go run .` from the module directory, so the documented local flow writes `misc/gnopreview/_preview/`; `git check-ignore -v --no-index misc/gnopreview/_preview/x` -> `.gitignore:14:_preview/`. Root-anchoring the line would stop ignoring the one output path a developer actually produces, so the unanchored form is required.
